hooks.note: Swift names the file id.uuidString, upper case; Kotlin's UUID.toString() is lower case, so images, PNGTuber and VTuber models in settings imported from iOS (or Moblin's system tests) were not found. uuidFile() renames files Loxen wrote in lower case.
Swift "\(id).mp4" writes the UUID in upper case, as HUUIDFILE.1.
